include.name: MoviesAddonClick
include.description: Add-on widget clicks. Kodi's built-in widget click did not open add-on folders (e.g. Next Page) from this skin's home shelf, so add-on mode handles every click itself: folders open in the Videos window, playable items play, anything else is run as a plugin call. Library/custom shelves keep Kodi's default click.
